native_button_record_fields.activated: byte at offset 0x11, set to one on activation
native_button_record_fields.trigger: byte at offset 0x13; values 1 press, 2 hold, 3 release, 4 left press

native_behavior: Scan buttons in array order and ignore non-hit rectangles using left/top-inclusive and right/bottom-exclusive bounds with 32-bit wrapped origin addition.
Trigger 1 accepts left press, left double-click, or right press; left action wins when both sides qualify.
Trigger 3 accepts left release before right release; trigger 4 accepts left press or left double-click only.
Trigger 2 follows the native held-button and edge-flag branches; selected parameters and activation state are stored before any callback.
Return the activated button index plus one; return zero if no button activates.

limitations: Callback pointers must be valid for any trigger that can select them, matching the native table precondition.
